SELECT fsd.id as detailId, fs.code, fs.shop_name AS shopName, fs.country_name AS countryName, fs.fulfillment_center AS fulfillmentCenter, fs.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, (SELECT fd.code FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER Join first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fdd.main_id = fd.id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fdd.fba_shipment_code = fs.code AND fd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY fd.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS deliveryCode, fs.platform_shipment_status AS platformShipmentStatus, fsd.asin, fsd.msku, fsd.fn_sku AS fnSku, fsd.sku_no AS skuNo, fsd.declare_qty AS declareQty, fsd.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, fsd.diff_qty AS diffQty, fs.shipment_create_time AS shipmentCreateTime, fsd.receive_date AS shipmentReceiveTime, fsd.receive_qty AS receiveQty, fs.is_packing_download as isPackingDownload FROM fba_shipment_detail fsd INNER JOIN fba_shipment fs ON fs.id = fsd.main_id AND fsd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and fs.is_deleted = FALSE
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT h.id,T.code, T.shop_name, G.sku_no, G.msku, h.receive_qty::VARCHAR receive_qty, TO_CHAR(h.receive_date , 'YYYY-MM-DD') receive_date FROM fba_shipment T LEFT JOIN fba_shipment_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id left join fba_shipment_receive h on g.id = h.detail_id
SELECT count(h.id) FROM fba_shipment T LEFT JOIN fba_shipment_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id left join fba_shipment_receive h on g.id = h.detail_id
